facts.statement: Free login rewards were given to all players, one item per day for seven days, provided the player logged in before the last day.
facts.quote: Que serán entregados al iniciar sesión diariamente, durante siete días.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language welcome-back news post for returning players. It lists a welcome-back bonus (extra game time and 43 days of membership for members whose Station account was updated before a early-May cutoff, and 20,000 Coins for lifetime members) and a seven-day free login gift schedule. The post gives no absolute date (only 'posted 2 weeks, 6 days ago' at capture) and contains a typo in the cutoff year ('201').
